items.idiom: Are you doing anything on Friday?
items.example: Are you doing anything on Friday evening?
Fancy going to the cinema tonight?

items.idiom: I'd love to, but I work late
items.translation: С удовольствием, но я допоздна на работе
items.example: I'd love to, but I work late tonight.
See you at seven outside the cinema.
I am running late, start without me!
We had to cancel our plans last night.
Let's have a night out on Saturday.
